build: S1c, the last stage of the plan kept record by record: a switch, set on each device, that joins two devices' plans instead of asking which to keep; another device's changes taken in when the page is idle, with undo and the selection kept; the messages that say what was taken in and what was changed on both, with Use mine. The join rules gain things taken whole (a job put off, a crop's selling line, a demand plan), keys of one record joined as one value, and the batches of a demand plan following the plan that stands.

changes.did: A phone and a computer can both change the plan without one losing the other's work: under Backup, Cloud sync, set each device to “Keep both, record by record”.
steps: Backup, Cloud sync has a new line, “When two devices have both changed the plan”. Press “Keep both, record by record”: it asks first, takes a snapshot and downloads a backup, and then stays pressed. Do the same on the second device.
Tick a sowing on one device and change a planting on the other. Within about a minute each says “Taken in from” the other, by its name, and holds both changes; Undo still works on each.

Change the same planting’s note on both. The second device to sync keeps the other’s note, and a strip across the top says something was changed on both devices: “See what differed” lists it, with “Use mine”.
